content_en.prompt: A balloon machine creates pictures by inflating balloons labelled A-F in a square frame, reading letters left to right: an empty balloon inflates until it touches another balloon or the frame edge; an inflated balloon deflates instead. To start, all balloons are deflated, and the machine reads a sequence of nine letters to produce a target image.
content_en.question: Which of the following sequences will NOT produce the target image?

options.text: B E B C A C B D B
B E C B A C B D B
B E B C A B D C B
B E C B A B C D B

content_en.explanation: There are exactly four 9-letter sequences that correctly produce the target image, found by representing the required inflation order as a directed graph (an arrow from X to Y means balloon X must be inflated before Y, with two places in the graph where the order of B and C can be swapped) and finding all its topological orderings. Sequence C (B E B C A B D C B) does not follow one of these valid orderings, so it fails to produce the target image.
content_en.ct_explanation: The sequence of letters is a computer program controlling a machine — each letter is a statement that inflates or deflates a balloon, and as with most such programs, the order of statements matters (e.g. 'B E' produces a different result than 'E B'). The directed graph used to find valid sequences has no cycles, so it is called a directed acyclic graph (DAG); any DAG has at least one topological ordering, and fast algorithms exist to construct one. DAGs have many applications in informatics, such as task scheduling. (This task reuses the same balloon-machine mechanic as an earlier, simpler task in this booklet, but with six balloons and nine letters instead of five and five, giving four valid topological orderings instead of one unique order.)

content_zh.prompt: 一台氣球機器，會在一個方形框架裡，把標示著A到F的氣球充氣，藉此畫出圖案，它會從左到右依序讀取字母：如果目前字母對應的氣球是空的，就會幫它充氣，直到碰到另一個氣球或框架邊緣為止；如果那個氣球已經是充氣狀態，就會改為放氣。一開始所有氣球都是消氣狀態，機器會讀取一串9個字母的序列，畫出目標圖案。
content_zh.question: 下面哪一組字母序列，沒辦法產生目標圖案？

options.text: B E B C A C B D B
B E C B A C B D B
B E B C A B D C B
B E C B A B C D B

content_zh.explanation: 剛好有四組9個字母的序列能正確產生目標圖案，可以透過把「必要的充氣順序」畫成一張有向圖來找出（從X指向Y的箭頭代表氣球X必須在氣球Y之前充氣，圖中有兩個地方B和C的順序可以互換），再找出這張圖所有的拓樸排序。序列C(B E B C A B D C B)不符合任何一種合法的拓樸排序，所以沒辦法產生目標圖案。
content_zh.ct_explanation: 這串字母序列其實就是一支控制機器的電腦程式——每個字母都是一條讓氣球充氣或放氣的指令，就像大多數這類程式一樣，指令的順序非常重要（例如「B E」跟「E B」會產生不一樣的結果）。用來找出合法序列的這張有向圖裡沒有環，所以叫做「有向無環圖」（DAG）；任何一張DAG都至少存在一種拓樸排序，而且有快速的演算法可以求出它。DAG在資訊科學裡有很多應用，例如工作排程。（這一題沿用了題本裡較前面一題較簡單版本的氣球機器機制，但這裡有6顆氣球、9個字母，而不是5顆氣球、5個字母，因此有4種合法拓樸排序，而不是唯一的一種順序。）
